statements.text: This SOP governs the end-to-end IVIG home infusion process at CareIG Specialty Pharmacy — from referral receipt through claim payment.
statements.quote: This SOP governs the end-to-end IVIG home infusion process at CareIG Specialty Pharmacy — from referral receipt through claim payment.

statements.text: All staff performing intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, clinical scheduling, or billing must follow this document.
statements.quote: All staff performing intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, clinical scheduling, or billing must follow this document.

statements.text: It references standard tools including spreadsheets, email, Slack, shared file storage, and calendar.
statements.quote: It references standard tools including spreadsheets, email, Slack, shared file storage, and calendar.

statements.text: No proprietary EHR, clearinghouse portal, or payer portal is required.
statements.quote: No proprietary EHR, clearinghouse portal, or payer portal is required.

statements.text: All case data lives under a case folder named CASE_ID (format: LastName_MMDDYYYY), where the date is the patient's DOB.
statements.quote: All case data lives under a case folder named CASE_ID (format: LastName_MMDDYYYY), where the date is the patient's DOB.

statements.text: This CASE_ID is used in all audit log entries, Slack posts, and file references throughout this SOP.
statements.quote: This CASE_ID is used in all audit log entries, Slack posts, and file references throughout this SOP.

statements.text: Team communications use defined Slack channels.
statements.quote: Team communications use defined Slack channels.

statements.text: Claims are submitted by email with PDF attachments.
statements.quote: Claims are submitted by email with PDF attachments.

statements.text: All major actions are logged to audit_log.xlsx.
statements.quote: All major actions are logged to audit_log.xlsx.

statements.text: For any date you write in files, use the YYYY-MM-DD format, except if specified otherwise.
statements.quote: For any date you write in files, use the YYYY-MM-DD format, except if specified otherwise.

statements.text: Covered drugs: Gammaplex, Octagam, Gammagard S/D, Gammagard Liquid, Privigen, Gamunex-C, Hizentra, HyQvia.
statements.quote: Covered drugs: Gammaplex, Octagam, Gammagard S/D, Gammagard Liquid, Privigen, Gamunex-C, Hizentra, HyQvia.

statements.text: If you encounter a situation not covered by this SOP, do not guess.
statements.quote: If you encounter a situation not covered by this SOP, do not guess.

statements.text: Stop work on that step, note what happened in audit_log.xlsx, and contact your direct supervisor immediately using the escalation path in Section 12.
statements.quote: Stop work on that step, note what happened in audit_log.xlsx, and contact your direct supervisor immediately using the escalation path in Section 12.

statements.text: When in doubt, always escalate before acting.
statements.quote: When in doubt, always escalate before acting.

statements.text: Audit Logging
statements.quote: Audit Logging

statements.text: Append one row to audit_log.xlsx at each major checkpoint.
statements.quote: Append one row to audit_log.xlsx at each major checkpoint.

statements.text: Columns: Date | CASE_ID | Action | File_Updated | Field_Updated | New_Value | Staff_User | Result (SUCCESS / FAILED / STOP — reason).
statements.quote: Columns: Date | CASE_ID | Action | File_Updated | Field_Updated | New_Value | Staff_User | Result (SUCCESS / FAILED / STOP — reason).

statements.text: Do not log every substep — only the checkpoints called out in each section.
statements.quote: Do not log every substep — only the checkpoints called out in each section.

statements.text: The Stop Protocol (Section 4.2) is itself a checkpoint — always log a stop event when triggered, even though it is not listed as a checkpoint within a specific workflow section.
statements.quote: The Stop Protocol (Section 4.2) is itself a checkpoint — always log a stop event when triggered, even though it is not listed as a checkpoint within a specific workflow section.

statements.text: Stop Protocol
statements.quote: Stop Protocol

statements.text: When a validation condition fails: note the reason in audit_log.xlsx with action 'Stop Protocol' and columns File_Updated, Field_Updated, and New_Value set to N/A, and hold the case until the issue is resolved.
statements.quote: When a validation condition fails: note the reason in audit_log.xlsx with action 'Stop Protocol' and columns File_Updated, Field_Updated, and New_Value set to N/A, and hold the case until the issue is resolved.

statements.text: Do not move to the next step until your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared.
statements.quote: Do not move to the next step until your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared.

statements.text: Prohibited Actions
statements.quote: Prohibited Actions

statements.text: Do not bill any IVIG drug J-code when clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ CareIG.
statements.quote: Do not bill any IVIG drug J-code when clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ CareIG.

statements.text: Do not bill pre-medication J-codes unless visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered documents drug, dose, route, time, and indication.
statements.quote: Do not bill pre-medication J-codes unless visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered documents drug, dose, route, time, and indication.

statements.text: Do not use ordered dose for unit calculations — always use visit_note.xlsx col Dose_Administered_Grams.
statements.quote: Do not use ordered dose for unit calculations — always use visit_note.xlsx col Dose_Administered_Grams.

statements.text: Do not submit a claim when claim.xlsx already has Submission_Date populated for the same DOS.
statements.quote: Do not submit a claim when claim.xlsx already has Submission_Date populated for the same DOS.

statements.text: Do not write off any balance >$200 without Director of Revenue Cycle approval (Slack #billing-mgmt).
statements.quote: Do not write off any balance >$200 without Director of Revenue Cycle approval (Slack #billing-mgmt).

statements.text: Do not respond to legal threats or attorney communications — post to #compliance immediately.
statements.quote: Do not respond to legal threats or attorney communications — post to #compliance immediately.

statements.text: Do not assign an ICD-10 code not supported by the physician's documentation and the PA approval.
statements.quote: Do not assign an ICD-10 code not supported by the physician's documentation and the PA approval.

statements.text: Phone Call Workaround
statements.quote: Phone Call Workaround

statements.text: When a step requires a phone call, check whether the required information has already been provided via email, referral document, or another input file.
statements.quote: When a step requires a phone call, check whether the required information has already been provided via email, referral document, or another input file.

statements.text: If the information is already available, proceed using that source and log the source in the relevant call log field, if appropriate.
statements.quote: If the information is already available, proceed using that source and log the source in the relevant call log field, if appropriate.

statements.text: If the information is not available and a call cannot be made, follow the Stop Protocol (Section 4.2).
statements.quote: If the information is not available and a call cannot be made, follow the Stop Protocol (Section 4.2).

statements.quote: Patient Contact

statements.text: Call patient at intake.xlsx col Patient_Phone. Verbatim script:

statements.text: "Hello, may I speak with [Patient Name]?
statements.quote: "Hello, may I speak with [Patient Name]?

statements.text: This is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy.
statements.quote: This is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy.

statements.text: Dr. [Physician_Name] has referred you for home IVIG infusion therapy.
statements.quote: Dr. [Physician_Name] has referred you for home IVIG infusion therapy.

statements.text: I'm calling to verify your information and explain next steps.
statements.quote: I'm calling to verify your information and explain next steps.

statements.text: Do you have a few minutes?"
statements.quote: Do you have a few minutes?"

statements.text: If no answer, leave this voicemail verbatim — do not state the diagnosis:
statements.quote: If no answer, leave this voicemail verbatim — do not state the diagnosis:

statements.text: "Hello, this is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy at [Phone].
statements.quote: "Hello, this is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy at [Phone].

statements.text: We received a referral from your physician.
statements.quote: We received a referral from your physician.

statements.text: Please call us back at your convenience.
statements.quote: Please call us back at your convenience.

statements.text: Thank you."
statements.quote: Thank you."

statements.text: When patient is reached: confirm demographics, explain the consent requirement, and email the consent form to intake.xlsx col Patient_Email. Set intake.xlsx col Consent_Status = Form Sent.

statements.text: Use the following rules:
statements.quote: Use the following rules:

statements.text: Drug J-Code | Look up J-code in jcodes.xlsx for Drug_Name_Trade. Units = (Dose_Administered_Grams × 1000) ÷ unit size. See Section 13 for full table and examples. If the result is not a whole number, round down to the nearest integer. Example: 25.3g Privigen = 50,600mg ÷ 500 = 101.2 → bill 101 units.
statements.quote: Drug J-Code | Look up J-code in jcodes.xlsx for Drug_Name_Trade. Units = (Dose_Administered_Grams × 1000) ÷ unit size. See Section 13 for full table and examples. If the result is not a whole number, round down to the nearest integer. Example: 25.3g Privigen = 50,600mg ÷ 500 = 101.2 → bill 101 units.

statements.text: Nursing Code | If Visit_Duration_Minutes is 60 or less, bill 99600 × 1 only. Do not bill 99603. Read benefits.xlsx col Nursing_Code_Pref. Blank or 99600: bill 99600 × 1 + 99603 × floor((Visit_Duration_Minutes − 60) ÷ 60). G0153 (Medicare Part B): bill G0153 × 1 only. T1029/T1032: verify per state in payer_rules.xlsx.
statements.quote: Nursing Code | If Visit_Duration_Minutes is 60 or less, bill 99600 × 1 only. Do not bill 99603. Read benefits.xlsx col Nursing_Code_Pref. Blank or 99600: bill 99600 × 1 + 99603 × floor((Visit_Duration_Minutes − 60) ÷ 60). G0153 (Medicare Part B): bill G0153 × 1 only. T1029/T1032: verify per state in payer_rules.xlsx.

statements.text: Saline | J7030 × NS_500mL_Bags_Used. J7050 × NS_250mL_Bags_Used. Both from visit_note.xlsx. For Gammaplex cases: do not bill J7030 or J7050. Instead bill A4221 for the Dextrose supply as part of the general infusion supplies line. Read Dextrose_500mL_Bags_Used from visit_note.xlsx to confirm administration was documented before billing.
statements.quote: Saline | J7030 × NS_500mL_Bags_Used. J7050 × NS_250mL_Bags_Used. Both from visit_note.xlsx. For Gammaplex cases: do not bill J7030 or J7050. Instead bill A4221 for the Dextrose supply as part of the general infusion supplies line. Read Dextrose_500mL_Bags_Used from visit_note.xlsx to confirm administration was documented before billing.

statements.text: Pre-Medications | Parse visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered. Diphenhydramine: J0171 × (mg ÷ 50). Promethazine: J2550 × (mg ÷ 25). If None administered: leave blank.

statements.text: Supplies | A4221 × 1 per visit. If Pump_Used = YES: also A4222 × 1.

rule.text: All staff performing intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, clinical scheduling, or billing must follow this document.
This CASE_ID is used in all audit log entries, Slack posts, and file references throughout this SOP.
Team communications use defined Slack channels.
Claims are submitted by email with PDF attachments.
All major actions are logged to audit_log.xlsx.
For any date you write in files, use the YYYY-MM-DD format, except if specified otherwise.
If you encounter a situation not covered by this SOP, do not guess.
Stop work on that step, note what happened in audit_log.xlsx, and contact your direct supervisor immediately using the escalation path in Section 12.
When in doubt, always escalate before acting.
Append one row to audit_log.xlsx at each major checkpoint.
Columns: Date | CASE_ID | Action | File_Updated | Field_Updated | New_Value | Staff_User | Result (SUCCESS / FAILED / STOP — reason).
Do not log every substep — only the checkpoints called out in each section.
The Stop Protocol (Section 4.2) is itself a checkpoint — always log a stop event when triggered, even though it is not listed as a checkpoint within a specific workflow section.
*Reference the Drug column of this table whenever entering Drug_Name in files.*

procedures.name: Stop Protocol

steps.text: When a validation condition fails: note the reason in audit_log.xlsx with action 'Stop Protocol' and columns File_Updated, Field_Updated, and New_Value set to N/A, and hold the case until the issue is resolved.
Do not move to the next step until your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared.

inputs.fact: the reason the validation condition failed

decisions.rule: your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared
decisions.then: Move to the next step
decisions.else: Hold the case

must_not: When a validation condition fails: Do not move to the next step until your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared.

procedures.name: Patient Financial Counseling

steps.text: Before making this call, calculate the patient's estimated out-of-pocket using benefits.xlsx.
Add together any remaining deductible (Deductible_Individual minus Deductible_Met_YTD), then apply the Coinsurance_Pct to the expected billed amount, and add the Copay_Amount if applicable.

To estimate the billed amount, look up the ordered drug's J-code in fee_schedule.xlsx col Billed_Rate, multiply by the expected units, and add the estimated nursing and supply charges from the same file.
Use that dollar figure in the script below.
Log call in benefits.xlsx col Financial_Counseling_Log: [Date] [Time] — [outcome].
If patient reports hardship: set intake.xlsx col Financial_Hardship = YES and post to #intake-team: [FINANCIAL HARDSHIP] CASE_ID — refer to Patient Assistance Program.

procedures.name: Claim Construction

steps.text: Copy claim_blank.xlsx to create claim.xlsx for this case.
Use the following rules:

Drug J-Code | Look up J-code in jcodes.xlsx for Drug_Name_Trade. Units = (Dose_Administered_Grams × 1000) ÷ unit size. See Section 13 for full table and examples. If the result is not a whole number, round down to the nearest integer. Example: 25.3g Privigen = 50,600mg ÷ 500 = 101.2 → bill 101 units.

Nursing Code | If Visit_Duration_Minutes is 60 or less, bill 99600 × 1 only. Do not bill 99603. Read benefits.xlsx col Nursing_Code_Pref. Blank or 99600: bill 99600 × 1 + 99603 × floor((Visit_Duration_Minutes − 60) ÷ 60). G0153 (Medicare Part B): bill G0153 × 1 only. T1029/T1032: verify per state in payer_rules.xlsx.

Saline | J7030 × NS_500mL_Bags_Used. J7050 × NS_250mL_Bags_Used. Both from visit_note.xlsx. For Gammaplex cases: do not bill J7030 or J7050. Instead bill A4221 for the Dextrose supply as part of the general infusion supplies line. Read Dextrose_500mL_Bags_Used from visit_note.xlsx to confirm administration was documented before billing.
Pre-Medications | Parse visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered. Diphenhydramine: J0171 × (mg ÷ 50). Promethazine: J2550 × (mg ÷ 25). If None administered: leave blank.
Supplies | A4221 × 1 per visit. If Pump_Used = YES: also A4222 × 1.

Header / Auth Fields | PA_Number = auth.xlsx col PA_Number. Physician_NPI = intake.xlsx col Physician_NPI. CareIG_NPI and Tax_ID from payer_rules.xlsx. DOS = visit_note.xlsx col Visit_Date. ICD10 = intake.xlsx col Diagnosis_ICD10. CareIG Taxonomy Code from org_identifiers.xlsx.
Split-Bill (OON partner) | If clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ CareIG: leave all IVIG drug J-code fields blank. Set claim.xlsx col Billing_Model = Split — Drug billed by [Drug_Source].
Claim_Frequency_C ode | Enter 1 for all original claim submissions. Enter 7 when resubmitting a corrected claim. Enter 8 when voiding a duplicate. Write value to claim.xlsx col Claim_Frequency_Code.

Modifier | Read visit_note.xlsx col Route. If Route = IV: no modifier required on the drug J- code line. If Route = SQ: append modifier SC to the drug J-code line in claim.xlsx col Drug_Modifier. Write Drug_Modifier to claim.xlsx.
HyQvia 10% | SQ | J1575 | 10 | Check payer_rules.xlsx for hyaluronidase co-billing requirement.
Partial: ordered 30g, administered 20g → J1557 | Use 20g only: 20 × 1000 ÷ 500 = 40 units. Note in claim.xlsx col Partial_Infusion_Note.
To calculate Total_Billed for a claim: multiply each code's units by its Billed_Rate and sum all lines.
Write the result to claim.xlsx col Total_Billed.

procedures.name: Denial Actions by CARC Code

steps.text: CO-4 | Procedure code / modifier inconsistent | Correct modifier per visit_note.xlsx col Route. Resubmit.

CO-11 | Diagnosis inconsistent with procedure | Confirm ICD-10 in claim.xlsx matches PA approval in auth.xlsx. If mismatch: email intake.xlsx col Physician_Email. Subject: [ICD10 CLARIFICATION NEEDED] CASE_ID | DOS: [date]. Body: state the ICD-10 on the claim, the ICD-10 on the PA, and ask the physician to confirm the correct code in writing. Do not resubmit until written confirmation is received and saved to .
CO-16 | Claim lacks required information | Identify missing field from denial detail (NPI, taxonomy, PA number). Update claim.xlsx. Resubmit.

CO-18 | Duplicate claim | Check claim.xlsx Submission_Log for prior submission on same DOS. If confirmed duplicate: resubmit the original claim with claim frequency code 8 (void/cancel) via email to the payer billing address. Update claim.xlsx col Claim_Status = Voided. Do not delete the original row. If not: resubmit with frequency code 7.

CO-22 | COB — other payer may be primary | CO-22 means another payer is primary. Check benefits.xlsx col Secondary_Insurance. If a primary payer is listed that was not yet billed: submit a new claim to that payer first. When their EOB is received, save it as era_[DOS]_[PrimaryPayer].pdf and resubmit to the original payer with COB fields populated: COB_Other_Payer_Name, COB_Other_Payer_Member_ID, COB_Other_Payer_Paid, COB_Other_Payer_EOB_Date.
CO-50 | Non-covered service | File Level 1 appeal per Section 11.2.
CO-96 | Non-covered charge | Compare to payer_rules.xlsx contracted rate. If dispute: post to #billing-mgmt. Write-off requires Director approval.

CO-97 | Benefit not assigned | Open benefits.xlsx col Benefit_Type. If the benefit tier on the original claim does not match what is listed in benefits.xlsx (e.g., billed under pharmacy benefit but should be medical): correct claim.xlsx and resubmit. If the benefit tier on the claim matches benefits.xlsx and the payer still denies: file a Level 1 appeal per Section 11.2.

PR-1 / PR-2 / PR-3 | Deductible / Coinsurance / Copay | Read the patient responsibility amount directly from the ERA line item for this denial. Write that amount to claim.xlsx col Patient_Responsibility. Generate and send patient statement per Section 10.4.
OA-23 | Charge exceeds fee schedule | Compare Paid_Amount to contracted rate. If underpaid: post to #billing-mgmt per Section 12.
PI-204 | Not medically necessary | Gather PA approval, LMN, clinical notes, IgG labs from . File Level 1 appeal per Section 11.2.

policy_questions.question: 7.2:6 writes the channel as #intakemgmt, while 8.1:14, 8.4:6 and 12.1:2 write #intake-mgmt. Is it the same channel?
Several statements name a folder whose name is missing from the text ("saved to .", "from .", "A file in has", "separate MD order in .", "Required Documentation in"). Which folder does each one mean?

Section 2 grants files to roles and names no tools. Rules here forbid each role only on the Jira and Shopify write tools, which the SOP never uses. Is that the grant you mean, and may every role use Slack, email and calendar?

The Roles table has empty entries: Patient Representative has no Reads From, and Billing Specialist has blanks in Writes To ("claim.xlsx, , ") and in Reads From. Which files go there, and which role writes the DENIAL files and appeals_log.xlsx?

8:2 sets PA_Status = Not Required and PA_Number = N/A when no PA is needed, but 10.1:5 holds billing unless PA_Status = Approved, and 10.1:7 needs a PA_Expiration_Date. How does a no-PA case pass Pre-Billing Validation?

4.3:5 and 10.1:12 forbid a claim when Submission_Date is populated for the same DOS, but the CARC rows (CO-4, CO-16, CO-18, CO-97) and 10.2:11 say to resubmit. Is a corrected resubmission an exception to 4.3:5, and must it pass 10.1:12?

9.1:3 says all columns except NS_500mL_Qty_Ordered should contain YES, but Drug_Lot_Number and Drug_NDC hold values, Drug_Delivery_Confirmed records a date, and Benadryl_Available may be N/A. What must each of these hold for the checklist to be complete?
8.5:6 acts after 2 days and Template 2 tells the physician 2 business days. Which one counts?
Are the "2 or more days" of 8.4:3 and the "5 days" of 8.4:6 and 12.1:2 calendar days or business days? Section 8.4 is done every business day.
12.1:3 "Claim unpaid, no ERA" gives no number of days. After how many days is the [AR FOLLOWUP] post due?
4.3:6 and 12.1:6 require Director approval above $200, and 11.1:8 says write-off requires Director approval with no amount. Who approves a write-off of $200 or less, and does it need a post?
8.3:2 takes the PA address from payer_rules.xlsx col PA_Submission_Email, and 7.1:7 collects PA_Submission_Email from the payer into benefits.xlsx. Which one wins if they differ?
11.1:6 reads benefits.xlsx col Secondary_Insurance, but the BV table has no such column and 6.1:9 keeps Secondary_Insurance_Name in intake.xlsx. Which column is meant?

Some columns are cited under names that the intake table does not list: Physician_Phone (8.1:7), Patient_Phone (6.2:2, the table has Phone), Primary_Payer_Phone (7.1:2, the table has Payer_Phone). Are these the same columns, and where does Physician_Phone come from?
10.2:4 rounds down only the drug J-code units. How are pre-medication units rounded when mg ÷ 50 or mg ÷ 25 is not a whole number?
For T1029/T1032 the text says only to verify per state. How many units are billed, and what is done if payer_rules.xlsx does not confirm the state?

13.5:7 says Accredo / Coram (OON) "CareIG bills nursing only" and then lists supplies, pre-med J-codes and saline; 7.2:5 says nursing and supplies only. Which codes may CareIG bill when another pharmacy supplies the drug?
Three words of 8.2 are open: "dated within 90 days" of which date, IgG lab "if applicable" for which diagnoses, and what makes a document "invalid" other than a failed date or signature?
The text describes filing Level 1 and what to do when Level 2 is denied, but not what starts a Level 2 appeal. When is it filed, and is there a deadline for either level?
11.2:2 lists five documents to gather and Template 3 also lists lab results. Are lab results required in every appeal?
13.5:2 says "Apply MSP rules" and "Verify MAC", and the text defines neither. What must the agent do for these?
9.2:2 says to select a nurse by zip code and credential, and no file named in the SOP lists nurses. Where is the list?
6.2:21 says "Assign BVS" and gives no way to choose one. How is the BVS chosen?

7.3:3 adds the remaining deductible and applies Coinsurance_Pct to the expected billed amount. Is coinsurance taken before or after the deductible is removed, and is the result capped by the remaining OOP_Max_Individual?
File names use [DOS] (claim_[DOS].pdf, era_[DOS]_[Payer].pdf, DENIAL_[CARC]_[DOS].xlsx). Does the YYYY-MM-DD format of 1:10 apply to these names?
